title: Recover a stalled Blueprint
objective: Create a recovery plan when DITL interviews have been cancelled twice.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Blueprint engagements stall when the urgency, the sponsor, or the next step disappears. Recover by diagnosing which one is missing, not by sending more material.

items: **Urgency:** is the business problem still a priority? Has something changed?
**Sponsor:** is the executive still engaged? Has the champion lost access or influence?
**Next step:** is there an agreed, dated action with an owner?
**Evidence:** is the case blocked by a missing baseline, a source, or a feasibility question?

blocks.x: Re-engage the champion with a specific, useful offer, such as a short recap of the agreed priorities with a proposed next decision. Confirm or replace the sponsor path. If the priority has really changed, record that honestly. A clear "not now" is better than a false forecast.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: Don't flood the customer with generic content or invent urgency. Update the opportunity record accurately.
Name the cause before choosing the fix. Each of the four causes has a different recovery.

blocks.title: Diagnosing a stalled engagement
blocks.alt: A two-by-two grid of the four causes of a stall: urgency, the sponsor, the next step, and the evidence. Each quadrant names the recovery action.

tl.label: Urgency
tl.detail: Revisit why now with the sponsor

tr.label: Sponsor
tr.detail: Re-engage or find a new sponsor

br.label: Evidence
br.detail: Close the gap with the smallest session
